title: Zacks Value Trader Highlights: ADM, Delek and Sanmina
author: Tracey Ryniec
description: Zacks Value Trader podcast episode highlights three undervalued stocks with strong buy ratings: ADM (agricultural supply chain manager with 52.2% expected earnings growth and 94-year dividend history), Delek US Holdings (downstream energy company with 139.8% expected earnings growth and forward P/E of 5.3), and Sanmina (manufacturing solutions company capturing AI data center spending with 100% expected earnings growth). title: TTM Technologies' N+M Technology Ramps Up: Can Revenue Soar?
author: Na
description: TTM Technologies (TTMI) is ramping up N+M technology production to capitalize on surging AI-driven data center demand, expecting approximately $600 million in N+M business in the second half of 2026. Data Center and Networking sales jumped 91% year-over-year, with better-than-expected yields supporting margin expansion. However, TTMI faces competitive pressure from Amphenol and Sanmina in advanced electronics and PCB capabilities.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong growth catalysts with $600M N+M revenue expected in H2 2026, 91% YoY sales growth in data center segment, better-than-expected yields, projected 50.88% revenue growth in 2026, and Zacks Rank #1 Strong Buy rating.

Mentioned as a competitive threat to TTMI through its Wilder Technologies acquisition, strengthening position in high-speed electronics and data-center applications, but no specific performance metrics provided.

Identified as a direct PCB competitor to TTMI with expanding high-technology capabilities for AI and aerospace-defense products, backed by capacity investments, but presented as competitive pressure rather than a growth opportunity.

title: Can Celestica's Next-Generation HealthTech Portfolio Lift Its Shares?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Celestica Inc. is positioned to benefit from the expanding HealthTech market through its advanced manufacturing, engineering and supply chain solutions for medical devices. The company's portfolio spans imaging systems, surgical equipment, diabetes care and diagnostic products. With a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating, earnings estimates for 2026 and 2027 have increased significantly, though shares have underperformed the industry over the past year.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Buy rating from Zacks, significant earnings estimate increases (11.4% for 2026, 30.2% for 2027), well-positioned in growing HealthTech market with comprehensive portfolio and global manufacturing capabilities. However, shares underperformed industry by 11% over past year.
Identified as a key competitor with broad HealthTech business and strong manufacturing capabilities, but no specific performance metrics or outlook provided in the article.

title: AST SpaceMobile vs. Jabil: Which Connectivity Stock is a Better Buy?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Jabil (JBL) is recommended as the better investment choice over AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) for 2026. While ASTS has outperformed with a 54.7% gain over the past year, JBL is expected to see 30.7% EPS growth compared to ASTS's projected 69.4% EPS decline. JBL trades at a significantly lower valuation (0.75 forward sales vs. ASTS's 44.49) and has shown more stable earnings estimates, making it the more attractive pick despite both carrying a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

insights.sentiment_reasoning: ASTS faces significant headwinds including projected 69.4% EPS decline in 2026, 53.4% downward revision in EPS estimates over 60 days, elevated spending pressures, intense competition from Starlink and Globalstar, and trades at an extremely rich valuation (44.49 forward sales multiple) despite strong recent price performance.

JBL is positioned as the better investment with expected 30.7% EPS growth in 2026, stable earnings estimates over the past 60 days, attractive valuation (0.75 forward sales), strong operational execution, global presence across 100 locations in 30 countries, and exposure to growing markets like AI data centers and 5G infrastructure.
